name: Scorpion
descriptions: Fold the paper in half vertically, then unfold. This creates a guide crease.
Bring the left edge in, but not all the way to the center — leave room for the claws.
Bring the right edge in to match.
Fold the top-left corner outward. This forms the scorpion's left claw (pincer).
Fold the top-right corner outward. This forms the right claw.
Fold the bottom up. This starts the tail.
Fold the tail forward over the body. Scorpions carry their tail curved over their back.
